description: Remove one recruit a vanilla nation has (Mekone, untouched: unit 3120): the game offers only #clearrec, so the editor clears the recruitment lists and adds every other recruit and commander back. The oracle reads the game's lists only after mods (post-processing), so at parse time it sees the lists written out: units and commanders from nothing to Mekone's others (vanilla.dm). Its walls and guards (#wallunit, #guardunit: not recruitment, the oracle ignores them) stay: re-read.
